answer: At random moments, every agent must pass a simultaneous liveness puzzle within ten seconds. Agents answering from the same oasis, a shared network or hosting pool, get puzzles whose difficulty scales with their count there: the k-th faces k times the work, so n fakes need about n squared over two compute at once. Payouts begin only after an agent holds a mesa of thirty straight passes, and no clustered agent may climb to the zenith of reputation.
